chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Saif, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Sabir, the mawla of Bassam, who said:
Did Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) recite the two Mu'awwidhat (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas) in the Maghrib prayer?

key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: The two Mu'awwidhat (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas)

ai.seo_question: Did the Imam recite Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas in the Maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the practice of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in reciting the two 'Mu'awwidhat' (Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas) during the Maghrib prayer, a practice that underscores the Shia emphasis on seeking divine protection against evil. The inclusion of this hadith in the chapter detailing prayer specifics highlights the scholarly consensus on the Sunnah of reciting these surahs as part of the obligatory prayer structure. This practice reflects the broader theological theme of relying on Allah's protection from internal and external harms, a central motif in Shia jurisprudence.
